title: Fix Flow Control line color and auto-zoom to last day on all charts

requirements.text: In FanVoltageFlowControlChart.tsx, fix the 'Flow control (Pa)' line color so it renders black in light mode and white in dark mode (currently inverted).

quotes: Alleen de grafiek met 'Flow control (Pa)' krijgt de aangepaste lijnkleur — zwart in lichte modus, wit in donkere modus

acceptanceCriteria: In light mode, the 'Flow control (Pa)' line in FanVoltageFlowControlChart is visually black.
In dark mode, the 'Flow control (Pa)' line in FanVoltageFlowControlChart is visually white.
No other chart line colors are affected.

requirements.text: On initial page load, all charts (TemperatureChart, CO2Chart, CoolingHeatingVentilationChart, FanVoltageFlowControlChart, TSICSensorChart) must automatically zoom into the last day of available data. The user must still be able to zoom out manually to view the full dataset.

quotes: automatisch inzoomen op de laatste dag bij het laden van de site, met de mogelijkheid om handmatig uit te zoomen naar de volledige dataset
Automatisch inzoomen op de laatste dag bij het laden van de site, met de mogelijkheid om handmatig uit te zoomen

acceptanceCriteria: When the page loads, every chart's visible time window is automatically set to the last 24 hours (last day) of available data.
The Brush and/or zoom state is initialized to the last day range on mount.
Users can manually drag or reset the Brush/zoom to view earlier data or the full dataset.
This auto-zoom behavior applies to all chart components: TemperatureChart, CO2Chart, CoolingHeatingVentilationChart, FanVoltageFlowControlChart, and TSICSensorChart.

constraints: Do not modify any file under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Only the FanVoltageFlowControlChart line color for 'Flow control (Pa)' should be changed — no other chart colors.
nonGoals: Adding new charts or data sources.
Changing auto-refresh or data fetching intervals.
